summary: Make one change produce a visible, attributable response while preserving the baseline.
objective: Repeat the baseline before and after the altered case; unexplained differences are investigated instead of attributed to the selected input.
example_prompts: Make one change produce a visible, attributable response while preserving the baseline.

principles: Write the question first: which input changes, which outcome should respond and which conditions stay fixed?
A side-by-side pair can compare states; a replay can compare time evolution. Neither needs decorative motion.
implementation: Capture baseline input, camera, lighting, model time and seed if randomness exists. Expose one independent control for the selected question.
For a drop test vary release height; for material inspection vary finish under fixed lights; for gear motion vary the radius ratio while paused.
Show the changed input beside an observable result and retain a reset action that restores the entire baseline.
observable_checks: Repeat the baseline before and after the altered case; unexplained differences are investigated instead of attributed to the selected input.
The result can be observed at the intended camera distance without reading debug logs.

known_limits: This is an authored inspection method, not a controlled scientific study or a numerical accuracy guarantee.
Authored reusable guidance; no runtime artifact or improvement has been observed for this record.
creative_affordances: Adapt proportions, finish and presentation to the scene; explain deliberate departures from this guidance.
